text: Per W3DS Protocol/Platform-Authentication.md: issuerJwksUri is supplied by the deployment, which could point at keys it controls and certify itself, so keys come from the trusted issuer's own /.well-known/jwks.json. The challenge is single-use, so a captured response cannot be replayed. Evidence is presented, so the verifier needs only public endpoints and never read access to the platform's eVault.
